## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Performance-Based Seismic Coefficient $k_h$"`

```{r}
p.target <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.16, "mean", 0.84, 0.90, 0.95)
IDn.target <- c("ensemble", "rigid", "flexible")
.ID.BASE <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
```

:::{.panel-tabset }

### Design Curves

```{r}
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  kmaxTable,
  "kh curves slide",
  suffix = ".max",
  target = .ID.BASE,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
.ID.BASE <- .targetBaseID(ID.target, "kh slide")
```

  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
